subject: Knock best practice
text:
Hi Carl,

Thanks for the time yesterday as discussed I am not surprised the chat widget didn't deliver many chat as people used to it being a bot and much more of a support solution and don't click on it for buying reasons.

From our experience and best practices adding a CTA will drive 73% higher engagement. 

The top locations where you can see the impact are:

• 

Top navigation - next to the book a demo.

• 

Footer - especially in Encord case where most clicks are on contact us in the footer. 

• 

Pricing page - in the enterprise tier where you need to book a demo to understand pricing, leads prefer to chat and ask questions before booking time. 

As mentioned we are happy to extend the trial in 2 months to make sure you see the value before you need to pay when adding the CTAs. I strongly believe that adding such CTAs in these main locations, will drive more engagement and with that conversions.

Please let me know if you would like me to share examples to how customers added such CTAs in different locations.

Best,

Alon 

 Hate emails, lets move to chat

 Alon Rosenberg

 Co-founder & CEO

text:
Thank you, Alyssa.  Some times that work for Patrick and me are noted below.  I will work with Datasite's internal attorney to review the MSA.  Does Encord have a DPA as well?  That will need to go to Datasite's attorney, and it will be helpful to provide a complete set of materials in the first pass.

Some additional items to highlight:

  *   Datasite's payable standard is 75 days.  For software and software subscriptions, that can be brought down to 60, and I can do that in this case.
  *   We will need a one-year quote to compare and present to Datasite's leadership (alongside the two-year quote that you shared).
  *   Once I have the one-year quote, then I can review that, with consultation with Datasite's sourcing market resources, to determine a landing point on the order form length, pricing, etc.
  *   Datasite's leadership will not engage new technology providers without a maintenance or ongoing service renewal cap.  Datasite will propose cap language in its edits to the MSA.  There is no immediate action for Encord on that piece; I am pointing that out for early awareness at this point.
  *   Order forms cannot auto-renew.  Datasite will review the terms around agreement terms, dates, etc. in the MSA and propose alternative language as needed.

This delegation will showcase the best of UK innovation in AI, Automation, and Advanced Software to key buyers, investors, and tech leaders across the region.

The mission will commence with meetings and engagements in Dallas, a global hub for corporate headquarters and home to 21 Fortune 500 companies including AT&T, Texas Instruments, American Airlines, and many more using applied AI. Then the delegation will head to Austin for SXSW—a world-renowned festival drawing over 300,000 innovators where delegates will have multiple opportunities to pitch, network, and showcase their tech to a global audience.

Delegates will receive:

  *   Showcase and pitching opportunities to key investors, buyers, and other technology ecosystem stakeholders in Dallas & Austin.
  *   Invitation to receptions & networking events with DBT and fellow trade mission participants.
  *   Promotional engagement including DBT promotion of your company’s participation in our trade mission across multiple communication channels.

Lean more about the criteria to apply here<http://events.great.gov.uk/SXSW2026AIMission>. The deadline to apply is 28 November 2025.
